description: Measure an LLM feature instead of vibe-checking it. Five modes. ANALYZE: read 20–30 real outputs, write one line each, group and count the failures before choosing any metric. BUILD: turn the top failure into an eval — planted-defect cases, a code grader first, an app:eval command, a baseline. COMPARE: change one lever (prompt, input, model, code), re-run, decide by a sign test. REDTEAM: prompt-injection cases for any step that reads text it didn't write; the attack success rate must be 0 against a control run. AUDIT: read-only review of an existing eval suite against the EV rules. Use whenever the user says "eval", "is my AI/agent/prompt any good", "measure the LLM feature", "recall/precision/pass rate", "LLM judge", "calibrate the judge", "red team the prompt", "prompt injection", "which model is good enough", or "audit my evals" — and when a prompt or model change needs proof before it ships. The runner reference targets Symfony AI (symfony/ai-*); the rules apply to any stack.
